profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer (Games) at LA Times Studios
profile.summary:
Jason graduated with distinction from The University of Calgary in 2000 with a BSc. in Mechanical Engineering.  His senior year design project was a submission to the Mines Action Canada technology competition, for which he and his team placed second nationally.

After graduation he moved to the United States to study computational fluid mechanics at Arizona State University.  In 2003 he finished a Masters Degree in Aerospace Engineering.

A lifelong gamer, he accepted a position at Rainbow Studios as a Simulations Engineer in 2004 working on vehicle and other physics/collision systems for Disney/Pixar's Cars and Cars2 : Maternational.    He also worked on the MX vs. ATV games doing vehicles, ragdoll, animation, IK, and other physics/collision systems.  In the fall of 2011, Jason moved to San Diego to work on THQ's UFC 4 title, doing combat physics and animation.

From 2010 - 2011 Jason taught classes in game development at Arizona State University, using the XNA development tools and Actionscript 3.

Mid 2012 he joined Trion Worlds Inc. doing vehicle/gameplay physics and general programming to ship their Syfy tied-in MMO-Shooter, Defiance.  Fall of 2013 he joined SOE, working on the the third installment in the EverQuest series, Everquest:Next, as well as their breakout battle royal shooter, H1Z1.

From 2018 - 2025, Jason worked on NantGames's mobile geolocation mmorpg Mythwalker, developing the interactivity generation tools/servers along with their static data, event, and client gameplay systems.

He currently works at LA Times Studios on an unannounced title.

Credited on Shipped Titles (spanning GameCube, Xbox, Xbox360, PS2, PS3, PS4, PC, Mobile)
MythWalker
Planetside Arena
H1Z1 (Z1BR)
Everquest : Landmark
Defiance
MX vs. ATV Alive
MX vs. ATV Reflex
Cars 2 : Maternational
Cars
MX vs. ATV Unleashed

Credit also on unshipped/cancelled titles in racing, open world character exploration and mixed martial arts.

Proficient:
3D math
Physics
Numerical simulation
C++ (Multiple IDE's)
Unity/C#
Console game programming
Code/Algorithm optimization
Creative problem solving

Familiarity:
Go
gRPC
